run_demo_gaussian: run the demo script that evaluates a bivariate Gaussian on a meshgrid and prints statistical moments
summarize_bivariate_gaussian_demo: summarize the demo_gaussian script that verifies a bivariate Gaussian integral sums to approximately 1
review_gaussian_bivariate_call: review the gaussian.bivariate_gaussian call that takes a mean vector and covariance matrix and returns a callable
test_gaussian_centroid: test that the x and y centroids of the evaluated Gaussian match the input mean vector
test_gaussian_moments: test that the second-order moments of the evaluated Gaussian match the input covariance matrix
